description: enables the default permissions. The remote URL is the sidecar origin the production window loads (see BACKEND_ORIGIN in src/lib.rs): tauri only treats devUrl/frontendDist as local, so without listing it here every IPC call from the shipped app is denied by the ACL. start-dragging is listed separately because core:window:default deliberately omits it (see the command table in tauri's build.rs), so data-tauri-drag-region is inert without it. updater:default is what lets the shipped app check/download updates at all — the updater only ever runs in release builds, i.e. exactly the remote-origin case, so omitting it here would break updates in the only build that uses them.
